@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+package grpc_middleware
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/blang/semver/v4"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.uber.org/zap"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
+)
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		header string
+		want   semver.Version
+	}{
+		{name: "prefixed version", header: "v1.2.3", want: semver.Version{Major: 1, Minor: 2, Patch: 3}},
+		{name: "unprefixed version", header: "1.2.3", want: semver.Version{Major: 1, Minor: 2, Patch: 3}},
+		{name: "missing header", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "malformed header", header: "not-a-version", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			if tt.header != "" {
+				ctx = metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, metadata.Pairs("x-flipt-accept-server-version", tt.header))
+			}
+			called := false
+			_, err := FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(zap.NewNop())(ctx, nil, nil,
+				func(ctx context.Context, _ interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+					called = true
+					require.Equal(t, tt.want, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+					return nil, nil
+				})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.True(t, called)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestWithFliptAcceptServerVersion(t *testing.T) {
+	version := semver.Version{Major: 2, Minor: 3, Patch: 4}
+	ctx := WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(context.Background(), version)
+	require.Equal(t, version, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+	require.Equal(t, semver.Version{Major: 1}, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(context.Background()))
+}
